liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Cold Rain And Snow** (1 review): Listener notes the song is historically relevant and describes the band's early material [7]
- **Viola Lee Blues** (1 review): Listener identifies this as their favorite version of the song [8]

## The recordings

- **gd1970-05-02.138227.sbd.miller.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 35 songs; 253 min; rated 4.53/5 by 17 [1]
- **gd1970-05-02.sbd.remaster.dp8outtake.100007.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 1 songs; 8 min; rated 3.75/5 by 12 [5]. Said about its sound: Listener suggests using EQ to enhance playback of the soundboard recording [6]
- **gd1970-05-02.sbd-fm-aud.unknown.108955.flac16**: soundboard; 36 songs; 220 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd1970-05-02.sbd.BEAR.gems.108673.flac24**: soundboard; 16 songs; 89 min; rated 4.09/5 by 11 [3]

## Around the show

- Listener asks why Latvala cut the song from the official release [8]
- Jerry Guitarist tuned up during the song because the band was out of tune [10]
- NRPS members joined the band for the performance of Cold Jordan [1]
- The setlist includes Glendale Train and Can't Pay The Price in set two [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1970-05-02.138227.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Master Reel (7inch @ 7.5ips 1/2trk) > Dat/48k [1]
- **gd1970-05-02.sbd.remaster.dp8outtake.100007.sbeok.flac16**: source: SBD > 3xcass (maxell XLII) [5]. Also: David Gans explains the song was left off Dick's Picks due to tuning issues; Right channel boosted by 2.5 decibels and pitch corrected using Tapers Section download [5][17]
- **gd1970-05-02.sbd-fm-aud.unknown.108955.flac16**: source: Gen 4 SBD Cassettes > SonyTC-W320 > Marantz 510 > CD [2]
- **gd1970-05-02.sbd.BEAR.gems.108673.flac24**: transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: reel> cass > cass Nak Dr-1 > Lynx Studio Interface at 32 bit float / 96 kHz Weiss Saracon for BRC to 24 bit / 96 kHz by Jamie Waddell [3]
